name: gold-chain-platform
description: Gold-backed stablecoin platform with blockchain explorer, wallet, and trade finance

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:explorer" "npm run dev:wallet"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd mock-server && npm install && cd ../explorer && npm install && cd ../wallet && npm install
scripts.audit:all: npm audit && cd mock-server && npm audit && cd ../explorer && npm audit && cd ../wallet && npm audit
scripts.start: npm run security && npm run dev
